gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (6/184)

chunks.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ قَالَ

translations.bn: আলী ইবন মুহাম্মদ, আল-হাসান ইবন আবদ আল-হামিদ থেকে, তিনি বলেন:
translations.de: Ali ibn Muhammad, von Al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Hamid, der sagte:
translations.en: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Hamid, who said:
translations.es: Ali ibn Muhammad, de Al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Hamid, quien dijo:
translations.fa: علی بن محمد، از حسن بن عبد الحمید، که گفت:
translations.fr: Ali ibn Muhammad, d’Al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Hamid, qui a dit :
translations.id: Ali ibn Muhammad, dari Al-Hasan ibn Abd al-Hamid, yang berkata:
translations.ru: Али ибн Мухаммад, от Аль-Хасана ибн Абд аль-Хамида, который сказал:
translations.tr: Ali ibn Muhammad, el-Hasan ibn Abd al-Hamid’den, o da şöyle dedi:
translations.ur: علی بن محمد، الحسن بن عبد الحمید سے، جنہوں نے کہا:
translations.zh: 阿里·伊本·穆罕默德，传自哈桑·伊本·阿卜杜勒·哈米德，他说：

chunks.arabic_text: شَكَكْتُ فِي أَمْرِ حَاجِزٍ فَجَمَعْتُ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ صِرْتُ إِلَى الْعَسْكَرِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيَّ لَيْسَ فِينَا شَكٌّ وَلَا فِيمَنْ يَقُومُ مَقَامَنَا بِأَمْرِنَا رُدَّ مَا مَعَكَ إِلَى حَاجِزِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ.

translations.bn: হাজিজের বিষয় নিয়ে আমি সন্দেহে পড়লাম, তাই আমি কিছু জিনিস সংগ্রহ করলাম, তারপর আমি আল-আসকারে গেলাম। তখন তিনি আমার কাছে বেরিয়ে এসে বললেন: “আমাদের সম্পর্কে কোনো সন্দেহ নেই, আর আমাদের আদেশে আমাদের স্থানে যে দাঁড়ায় তার সম্পর্কেও নয়। তোমার কাছে যা আছে তা হাজিজ ইবন ইয়াজিদকে ফিরিয়ে দাও।”
translations.de: Ich zweifelte in der Angelegenheit von Hajiz, also sammelte ich einige Dinge und ging dann nach al-ʿAskar. Da kam er zu mir heraus und sagte: „Es gibt keinen Zweifel über uns und auch nicht über denjenigen, der auf unseren Befehl hin an unserer Stelle steht. Gib das, was du bei dir hast, an Hajiz ibn Yazid zurück.“
translations.en: I doubted regarding the matter of Hajiz, so I gathered a few things, then I went to al-ʿAskar. Then there came out to me: “There is no doubt concerning us, nor concerning the one who stands in our place by our command. Return what is with you to Hajiz ibn Yazid.”
translations.es: Dudé acerca del asunto de Hajiz, así que reuní algunas cosas; luego fui a al-ʿAskar. Entonces salió hacia mí y dijo: “No hay duda acerca de nosotros, ni acerca de quien ocupa nuestro lugar por nuestra orden. Devuelve lo que tienes a Hajiz ibn Yazid.”
translations.fa: در کارِ حاجز دچار تردید شدم، پس چیزی گرد آوردم، سپس به العسکر رفتم. آنگاه او نزد من بیرون آمد و فرمود: «در مورد ما هیچ شکی نیست، و نه در مورد کسی که به فرمان ما به جای ما می‌ایستد. آنچه را با توست به حاجز بن یزید بازگردان.»
translations.fr: J’ai douté au sujet de l’affaire de Hajiz, alors j’ai rassemblé quelques choses, puis je me suis rendu à al-ʿAskar. Alors il sortit vers moi et dit : « Il n’y a aucun doute à notre sujet, ni au sujet de celui qui prend notre place sur notre ordre. Rends à Hajiz ibn Yazid ce que tu as avec toi. »
translations.id: Aku ragu tentang urusan Hajiz, lalu aku mengumpulkan beberapa barang, kemudian aku pergi ke al-ʿAskar. Lalu ia keluar menemuiku dan berkata: “Tidak ada keraguan tentang kami, dan tidak pula tentang orang yang menggantikan kedudukan kami atas perintah kami. Kembalikan apa yang ada padamu kepada Hajiz ibn Yazid.”
translations.ru: Я усомнился в деле Хаджиза, собрал кое-что, затем отправился в аль-Аскар. Тогда он вышел ко мне и сказал: «Нет сомнения относительно нас и нет сомнения относительно того, кто занимает наше место по нашему приказу. Верни то, что у тебя есть, Хаджизу ибн Язиду».
translations.tr: Hâciz’in işi hakkında şüpheye düştüm; bunun üzerine bazı şeyler topladım, sonra el-Asker’e gittim. Ardından bana çıktı ve şöyle dedi: “Bizim hakkımızda hiçbir şüphe yoktur; bizim emrimizle bizim yerimize geçen kimse hakkında da yoktur. Yanında olanı Hâciz ibn Yezid’e geri ver.”
translations.ur: میں حاجز کے معاملے میں شک میں پڑ گیا، تو میں نے کچھ چیزیں جمع کیں، پھر میں العسکر کی طرف گیا۔ پھر وہ میرے پاس باہر آیا اور کہا: “ہماری بابت کوئی شک نہیں، اور نہ ہی اس کے بارے میں جو ہمارے حکم سے ہماری جگہ قائم ہو۔ جو کچھ تمہارے پاس ہے اسے حاجز بن یزید کو واپس کر دو۔”
translations.zh: 我对哈吉兹的事情心存疑虑，于是我收集了一些东西，然后前往阿斯卡尔。随后他出来对我说：“对于我们没有任何怀疑，对于奉我们命令而代我们行事的人也没有怀疑。把你手中的东西归还给哈吉兹·伊本·亚齐德。”

seo_questions.bn: এই হাদিস কীভাবে ইমাম-নিযুক্ত প্রতিনিধির কর্তৃত্বকে নিশ্চিত করে?
seo_questions.de: Wie bekräftigt dieser Hadith die Autorität des vom Imam eingesetzten Vertreters?
seo_questions.en: How does this hadith affirm the authority of the Imam’s appointed representative?
seo_questions.es: ¿Cómo afirma este hadiz la autoridad del representante designado por el Imam?
seo_questions.fa: این حدیث چگونه اقتدار نماینده منصوبِ امام را تأیید می‌کند؟
seo_questions.fr: Comment ce hadith affirme-t-il l’autorité du représentant désigné par l’Imam ?
seo_questions.id: Bagaimana hadis ini menegaskan otoritas wakil yang ditunjuk oleh Imam?
seo_questions.ru: Как этот хадис подтверждает власть представителя, назначенного Имамом?
seo_questions.tr: Bu hadis, İmam’ın tayin ettiği temsilcinin otoritesini nasıl teyit eder?
seo_questions.ur: یہ حدیث امام کے مقرر کردہ نمائندے کی اتھارٹی کی تصدیق کیسے کرتی ہے؟
seo_questions.zh: 这段圣训如何肯定伊玛目所任命代表的权威？

summaries.bn: এই হাদিসটি ইমাম عليه السلام-এর কর্তৃত্ব এবং তাঁর আদেশে নিযুক্ত প্রতিনিধির প্রতি আস্থা নিশ্চিত করে। এটি হাজিজ ইবন ইয়াজিদ সম্পর্কে সন্দেহের প্রসঙ্গ তুলে ধরে এবং আমানতকৃত বস্তুগুলো তাকে ফিরিয়ে দিতে নির্দেশ দেয়, যা ঐশীভাবে অনুমোদিত ধর্মীয় কর্তৃত্বের নীতিকে জোরদার করে।
summaries.de: Dieser Hadith bekräftigt das Vertrauen in die Autorität des Imams عليه السلام und in den durch seinen Befehl eingesetzten Vertreter. Er behandelt den Zweifel bezüglich Hajiz ibn Yazid und weist an, die anvertrauten Gegenstände an ihn zurückzugeben, wodurch das Prinzip einer göttlich legitimierten religiösen Autorität hervorgehoben wird.
summaries.en: This hadith affirms confidence in the authority of the Imam عليه السلام and in the representative appointed by his command. It addresses doubt regarding Hajiz ibn Yazid and instructs that the entrusted items be returned to him, underscoring the principle of divinely sanctioned religious authority.
summaries.es: Este hadiz afirma la confianza en la autoridad del Imam عليه السلام y en el representante designado por su orden. Aborda la duda acerca de Hajiz ibn Yazid y ordena que los objetos confiados le sean devueltos, subrayando el principio de una autoridad religiosa sancionada divinamente.
summaries.fa: این حدیث، اعتماد به اقتدار امام علیه السلام و نماینده‌ای را که به فرمان او منصوب شده است، تأیید می‌کند. این روایت به تردید درباره حاجز بن یزید می‌پردازد و دستور می‌دهد اشیای سپرده‌شده به او بازگردانده شود، و بدین‌سان اصلِ اقتدار دینیِ تأییدشده از سوی خدا را برجسته می‌سازد.
summaries.fr: Ce hadith affirme la confiance dans l’autorité de l’Imam عليه السلام et dans le représentant désigné par son ordre. Il traite du doute au sujet de Hajiz ibn Yazid et ordonne que les objets confiés lui soient rendus, soulignant ainsi le principe d’une autorité religieuse sanctionnée divinement.
summaries.id: Hadis ini menegaskan keyakinan terhadap otoritas Imam عليه السلام dan terhadap wakil yang ditunjuk atas perintahnya. Hadis ini menyinggung keraguan tentang Hajiz ibn Yazid dan memerintahkan agar barang-barang yang dititipkan dikembalikan kepadanya, sekaligus menegaskan prinsip otoritas agama yang disahkan secara ilahi.
summaries.ru: Этот хадис подтверждает доверие к власти Имама عليه السلام и к представителю, назначенному по его повелению. В нем говорится о сомнении относительно Хаджиза ибн Язида и дается указание вернуть ему доверенные вещи, что подчеркивает принцип божественно утвержденной религиозной власти.
summaries.tr: Bu hadis, İmam’ın عليه السلام otoritesine ve onun emriyle tayin edilen temsilciye güveni teyit eder. Hâciz ibn Yezid hakkındaki şüpheyi ele alır ve emanet edilen eşyaların ona iade edilmesini emrederek ilahî onaylı dinî otorite ilkesini vurgular.
summaries.ur: یہ حدیث امام علیہ السلام کی اتھارٹی اور ان کے حکم سے مقرر کردہ نمائندے پر اعتماد کو ثابت کرتی ہے۔ یہ حاجز بن یزید کے بارے میں شک کا ذکر کرتی ہے اور امانت میں دی گئی چیزیں اسے واپس کرنے کا حکم دیتی ہے، جس سے الٰہی طور پر منظور شدہ دینی اتھارٹی کے اصول کی تاکید ہوتی ہے۔
summaries.zh: 这段圣训肯定了对伊玛目 عليه السلام权威以及奉其命令所 नियुक्त代表的信任。它涉及对哈吉兹·伊本·亚齐德的疑虑，并命令将托付之物归还给他，从而强调了神圣认可的宗教权威原则。

gradings: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (6/184)
text: شَكَكْتُ فِي أَمْرِ حَاجِزٍ فَجَمَعْتُ شَيْئاً ثُمَّ صِرْتُ إِلَى الْعَسْكَرِ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيَّ لَيْسَ فِينَا شَكٌّ وَ لَا فِيمَنْ يَقُومُ مَقَامَنَا بِأَمْرِنَا رُدَّ مَا مَعَكَ إِلَى حَاجِزِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ .

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Abdul Hameed who said,

‘I doubted regarding the matter of Hajiz, so I gathered a few things, then went to Al-Askar, and there came out (a letter from the 12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) to me: ‘There isn’t any doubt regarding us<sup>asws</sup> nor regarding the one who are standing in our<sup>asws</sup> place with our<sup>asws</sup> command. Return whatever is with you to Hajiz Bin Yazeed’.
en.sarwar: 13. Al-Hassan ibn al-Fadl ibn Yazid al-Yamani has said the following. “My father wrote in his own had writing he received back a response. I then wrote in my own hand writing I also received back a response. One of our Fuqaha’ (scholar of law) wrote in his own hand writing but he did not receive any response. We then began to think about it and we found out that the man had changed his belief into that of the Qirmati sect. Al-Hassan ibn al-Fadl has said, “I visited (the holy places in ) and arrived at Tus. I decided not to leave until I will experience evidence in support of my belief and success in achieving my needs even if it would take me to stay until I will receive confirmation.” He has said, “In the mean time I felt depressed because of fear that I might lose the opportunity to perform Hajj.” He has said, “One day I went to see Muhammad ibn Ahmad for help.” He said to me, “Go to so and so mosque. A man will meet you there.” I then went to the mosque and a man came to me. He looked at me and laughed and said, “do not be sad and depressed. You will perform Hajj this year and will return back to your wife and children safely.” The narrator has said, “I gained confidence and my heart felt at peace and I say that is how my wish came true.” The narrator has said, “I then went to the army camp (city of Surra man Ra’a ) and a bag of money with few Dinars and a piece of clothes were sent to me (from the Imam’s office). I felt depressed and said to my self, “Is this how these people treat me and this is how much my reward is with them?” I used ignorance and returned the gift and wrote a letter. The person who brought them to me did not explain or say any thing. I then felt regretful; very strongly and said to myself, “I have turned ungrateful to my master in rejecting his gift. I wrote a letter and begged for forgiveness of my misbehavior. I confessed to my sins and begged for pardon. I sent the letter and remained rubbing my hands against each other. In such condition I was thinking and say to myself, “If the money will be sent to me I will not open the bag and will not say anything about it. I will take it to my father. He knows more than me and will do whatever he would like. At that time a letter had come to the messenger who had brought the bag of money. He was told, “What you did was wrong. You did not inform the man that we sent gifts to our friends and followers and sometimes they ask us for such gift for blessings.” A letter came to me also and it said, “You made a mistake in rejecting the gift but when you asked Allah to forgive you Allah will forgive you. Since your intention was not to open the gift or spent it we have spent it on your behalf. However, you must take the cloth so you can use it for Ehram (during performing certain acts of Hajj).” The narrator has said, “I wrote him about two issue and I wanted to write about a third issue but I did not do so for fear that it might not like it.” The answer for the two issues came back and the meaning of the third one was also explained. All praise belongs to Allah. The narrator has said, “I made a contract with Ja‘far ibn Ibrahim al-Naysaburi in Naysabur to ride share on our journey to Makka. When we arrived in Baghdad I decided to change our agreement. I then went around to find another person for ride sharing. Ibn al-Wajna’.came to see me after that I had already proposed to him ride sharing and hiring a ride and he had expressed his dislike to my my proposal. He said, “I am looking for you and I am told, “He will accompany you. Treat him kindly, find for him ride sharing and hire for him a ride.”
